overview_description.description:
CodeSandbox makes it easier to express and validate product teams' ideations with code and aims to remove hassles when setting up a development environment, tooling, and sharing projects. Join us and help build the future of coding on the web.

Used by over 2M developers each month, including within organizations like Shopify, Atlassian, and Stripe, creators have crafted over 10M apps on the platform since launch. It’s used by thousands of open source projects, including React, Vue, and Babel, among others.

about_short_description.short_description: Free, instant, collaborative sandboxes for rapid web development.

product.name: CodeSandbox SDK
product.description: An API-driven platform to programmatically create and manage isolated cloud sandboxes for running code securely at scale.

product.name: MicroVM Infrastructure
product.description: A cloud-based microVM system that enables fast startup, cloning, and snapshotting of virtual machines for sandbox environments.

product.name: Cloud Development Environments (Sandboxes)
product.description: Cloud-hosted isolated development environments that allow developers to code, test, and collaborate without local setup.

product.name: Dev Containers Integration
product.description: Support for pre-configured development environments using Dev Containers, Dockerfiles, and Docker Compose.

product.name: VS Code Extension
product.description: An extension that connects the CodeSandbox cloud environment with the Visual Studio Code editor for live coding and collaboration.
